summary: Toyota Motor Corp. filed a Form 6-K containing a notice of partial changes to a previously announced simplified absorption-type company split. Toyota is the splitting company and OneStream Co., Ltd. is the successor. The split is effective June 29, 2026, with OneStream's capital stock expected to change to JPY 150,000,000. OneStream also resolved to issue Class A preferred shares via third-party allotment (subscription period June 30 – July 31, 2026). No financial terms or premium are disclosed. This corporate restructuring is a business reorganization and not an acquisition or divestiture. Monitor for completion of the share issuance and capital changes.
